description.value: AFURI is a Tokyo-origin ramen chain serving light, yuzu-accented broths alongside sushi and small plates at its Vancouver location on Main Street. The kitchen avoids artificial ingredients and preservatives, emphasising naturally derived umami from fresh, high-quality ingredients. Touring cyclists will find a full sit-down meal with vegan and gluten-free options, as well as online ordering for convenience.
